conv: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling from Example Dental Studio. Just so you know, this call may be recorded. May I speak with Alex?
Great, thanks! I'm calling to confirm your teeth cleaning on Thursday at 3 pm. Does that still work for you?
Hmm, could we make it a bit later? Like four?
Of course. So you'd prefer Thursday at 4 pm instead. I'll pass that on, and the team will call you back to confirm the new time. Is there anything else?
Thank you, have a great day. Bye!
